answer: Shards are assigned from the oasis graph, and therefore cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The voyage assignment is published and crystal records each panel. The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 3210 identities would post 1158 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
